title: Juicy Springy Middle Eastern Lentils Mujadara
description: Rich and flavorful Middle Eastern dish featuring lentils and Thai sweet basil, perfect for a quick and easy meal. This recipe is nut-free and uses dehydrated ingredients for convenience.
instructions: Rinse the lentils and drain well.
Combine the lentils and water in a medium saucepan and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes, or until the lentils are tender.
Meanwhile, heat the olive oil in a small skillet over medium heat.
Add the dehydrated onion to the skillet and cook, stirring occasionally, until fragrant.
Stir in the dried Thai sweet basil, salt, black pepper, and cumin.
Once the lentils are cooked, stir in the onion and spice mixture.
Serve the lentils hot, garnished with additional Thai sweet basil if desired.
